title: generate_all_charts.ipynb

canonical_node.axiom: All project visualizations shall be generated from a single, unified chart-generation notebook that imports all data and produces a consistent, publication-ready output suite.
definitions: Chart generation notebook: a single Colab notebook that produces all visualizations for the project in one execution.
Publication-ready output: PNG files at 300 DPI, organized into subdirectories by category.
Consistent formatting: uniform naming, sizing, and styling across all generated charts.
derivation: The project requires multiple visualizations across field theory, Lagrangian mechanics, and biblical empirical tests.
Generating charts inline in each test notebook would intermix test logic with presentation logic, reducing clarity.
A dedicated chart-generation notebook centralizes visualization code, ensuring consistency and ease of maintenance.
Running this notebook once produces the complete chart suite, saving time and reducing errors compared to running multiple notebooks.
canonical_node.action: Execute generate_all_charts.ipynb to generate all project charts, saving them to /content/charts/ in PNG format at 300 DPI, organized into field_theory/, lagrangian/, biblical/, and summary/ subdirectories.
boundary: Does not perform any new scientific analysis or testing; it only visualizes existing data.
Does not modify or validate the underlying data; it assumes data is already generated and available.
Does not produce interactive charts; output is static PNG files.
test: Run the notebook and verify that all expected chart files are created in the specified directories.
Check that each chart is in PNG format and has a resolution of 300 DPI.
Spot-check a sample of charts to ensure they match the expected visualizations (e.g., energy conservation plot is flat).

dg1_dependencies: All data-generating notebooks (e.g., field theory simulations, Lagrangian mechanics tests, biblical empirical tests) must have been run and their outputs saved.
The notebook must be run in a Google Colab environment with access to the project data files.
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a single-entry-point production pipeline for generating all visualizations, enabling consistent, publication-ready output without needing to run multiple notebooks.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the ability to generate each individual chart as before; the notebook aggregates existing visualization code, not replacing it.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If removed, the project loses a centralized chart generation capability, forcing users to run multiple notebooks or manually assemble charts, increasing effort and inconsistency risk.

overstatement_risks: The document claims the notebook produces 'publication-ready' output, but no evidence of actual publication or peer review is provided.
The phrase 'all visualizations' may overstate coverage if some charts are not included or if new tests are added later.
kill_conditions: If the notebook fails to generate all expected charts when run on current data.
If the output charts are not consistent in format or resolution.
risk.lean_target: A script that generates all charts from a single command, with a manifest of expected outputs.

plain_summary: This document describes a Colab notebook that generates all project visualizations in one run, saving them as high-resolution PNGs. It is an operational tool, not a scientific claim, and its value depends on the underlying data and tests.
